summary: 安装/升级演练执行首片 on BASE cbb84c2. Implements scripts/ops/install_drill.py (V1-OPS-01 preflight install diagnostics and V1-OPS-02 TLS/security probe) and scripts/ops/upgrade_drill.py (V1-OPS-03 upgrade/rollback rehearsal) against the PH-345 frozen contract: append-only JSONL evidence envelope v1 (script/contract_version/mode/profile/app_sha/started_at/finished_at/exit_code/status/checks/artifacts/redactions/notes), exit codes 0 pass / 2 not_run (missing prerequisite) / 3 fail / 4 environment error / 5 security refusal, dry_run default, idempotent evidence dedupe by script+profile+started_at, explicit production execute refusal (exit 5 blocked), isolated rehearsal only, redacted evidence, no production/customer data. Preflight checks runtime, git SHA, disk, Compose/DB declarations, append-only migration mode and refuses production execution; execute path is a disposable isolated rehearsal. TLS probe validates domain/validity/expiry/hostname/HSTS/Secure cookies, reports no-domain as not_run, and accepts an injected handshake for deterministic tests. Upgrade drill validates baseline/candidate SHA, verified non-empty backup evidence, append-only migration prefix, duplicate/destructive migration rejection and structural-compatible rollback, supports isolated execute with optional real migration against a temporary copied SQLite DB, and refuses production execution. Docs update ops-runbook/upgrade-recovery statuses from not implemented to local/rehearsal implemented with real staging/production marked not_run. Scoped 12 tests cover envelope/exit codes/idempotency/production refusal/TLS expired/hostname/migration regression/backup missing. No real deployment, TLS, restore, PG concurrency, performance, customer data, or production access was performed; those remain not_run. Reviewer round-1 blockers fixed: execute is now restricted to the isolated rehearsal profile for both scripts; staging and production execute return exit 5 blocked with safety.execute_profile, so a local temporary rehearsal can never claim a staging install/upgrade. Install preflight now requires an explicit migrations_append_only fact: missing evidence is not_run/exit 2, false is fail, only true passes; docs and report align with real staging/production not_run. Regressions cover staging execute on both scripts and missing migration evidence.

review.reviewer: independent PH-347 install/upgrade drill reviewer (fresh context, read-only)
findings: BLOCKER - staging execute produces a false pass: install_drill.preflight refuses only `profile == 'production'`; with `--env staging --mode execute` it falls through to a temporary local rehearsal manifest, records `install.rehearsal=pass`, and returns exit 0/pass for a staging install that was never performed. upgrade_drill.upgrade_plan has the same behavior: only production execute is refused; staging execute with a backup and migration facts returns pass from a temporary plan copy. The report/docs say real staging/production are not_run, so staging execute must not be able to claim pass. Fix: restrict `execute` to `profile == 'rehearsal'` (staging/production execute should return EXIT 5 blocked or EXIT 2 not_run with an explicit reason), and add regressions for staging execute on both scripts.

BLOCKER - missing migration fact defaults to pass in install preflight: `facts.get('migrations_append_only', True)` makes the migration.mode check pass when the fact is absent (e.g. compose/db facts supplied but no migration evidence), so the install drill can claim append-only migrations without evidence. Fix: require an explicit fact and emit not_run/fail when missing; add a test with compose/db present but no migration evidence.

OTHER CONTENT CHECKED: both scripts emit the PH-345 envelope fields (script/contract_version/mode/profile/app_sha/started_at/finished_at/exit_code/status/checks/artifacts/redactions/notes); exit-code mapping 0/2/3/4/5 and JSONL append-only evidence are implemented; production execute is refused with exit 5; TLS probe with no domain exits 2/not_run; upgrade execute requires backup and copies an isolated SQLite DB before migrate; smoke/real staging/production remain not_run/blocked and the docs reflect local/rehearsal-only evidence; scoped tests 12 OK; check 283; makemigrations clean; full 1236/5F+3E/69 known baseline; fresh verify_integrity ok; verify-change only review gate, no path_out_of_scope; 10 files within the PH-347 whitelist and no product code/migration/schema change.
